# Monokai

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai)

Monokai is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `monokai` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { monokai } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-monokai';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, monokai],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `monokai` | `Extension` |
| `monokaiMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#272822` |
| Active line | `#2f2f27` |
| Selection | `#3f3e35` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#ff809d` | bold | 6.25:1 | 5.67:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#ff809d` | bold | 6.25:1 | 5.67:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#ff809d` | - | 6.25:1 | 5.67:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#f8f8f2` | - | 13.94:1 | 12.65:1 | 10.09:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#FD971F` | - | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#FD971F` | - | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#66D9EF` | - | 9.01:1 | 8.18:1 | 6.53:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#A6E22E` | - | 9.58:1 | 8.70:1 | 6.94:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#66D9EF` | italic | 9.01:1 | 8.18:1 | 6.53:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#A6E22E` | italic | 9.58:1 | 8.70:1 | 6.94:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#FD971F` | italic | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |
| String | `string` | `#E6DB74` | - | 10.44:1 | 9.47:1 | 7.56:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#E6DB74` | - | 10.44:1 | 9.47:1 | 7.56:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#b897fc` | - | 6.28:1 | 5.70:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#b897fc` | - | 6.28:1 | 5.70:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#FD971F` | - | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#b3af99` | italic | 6.73:1 | 6.11:1 | 4.87:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#b3af99` | - | 6.73:1 | 6.11:1 | 4.87:1 |

| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#A6E22E` | - | 9.58:1 | 8.70:1 | 6.94:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#A6E22E` | bold | 9.58:1 | 8.70:1 | 6.94:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#FD971F` | italic | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | `#FD971F` | bold | 6.81:1 | 6.18:1 | 4.93:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#f8f8f2` | background, active line, selection | 10.09:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#b3af99` | gutter | 4.56:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#f8f8f0` | background, active line | 12.64:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#66d9ef` | background | 9.01:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #66D9EF` | background, active line | 8.18:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#ff809d, 1px solid #E6DB74` | background (fill or outline) | 10.44:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#3f3e35` | active line | 1.25:1 | Pass |
